note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a MOR 11(1); A06b MOR 11(1); L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Generally applicable provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Generally applicable provision), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: Group restriction: only if parent is member of a particular group, race or religion), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: by birth in the territory only on the condition the dataset states; by descent from either parent, with no further limit on a child born abroad. The coding also records a restriction to members of a particular group, which the form holds only in the condition's words, which the form doesn't hold. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Morocco, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in the country for at least 5 years. ... n.a. ... n.a. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born in Morocco to a citizen. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born abroad to a citizen. ... No provision ... Group restriction: only if parent is member of a particular group, race or religion ... Person is a minor who is born in Morocco and whose father was also born in the country. Other conditions: person resides in Morocco and the father comes from a country of Arab and Muslim majority and also belongs to this group. [NB: this article actually has two provisions: i) Person is born in Morocco to two parents also born there; ii) Person is born in Morocco to a father also born there coming from an Arab or Muslim majority country and belonging to this group].
